name: FNBO Evergreen Credit Card

base_rate.description: Unlimited 2% cash back (earned as points) on all purchases, including gas, groceries and utilities.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem for cash as a statement credit, an ACH deposit into a checking or savings account, or a mailed check.

signup_bonus.description: $200 bonus (20,000 points equivalent) after spending $1,000 within the first 3 billing cycles after account opening.

notes: APRs, fees and the foreign transaction fee are in the Summary of Credit Terms, which the product page loads with script, so they are null here. No Visa network package is stated for this card, so network_tier is none.
